scenario.missionStatement: At approximately 2026-04-05T06:45:00Z, the Maritime Operations Centre (MOC), Mumbai, received intelligence indicating multiple piracy incidents targeting commercial vessels transiting the Internationally Recommended Transit Corridor (IRTC) in the western Arabian Sea. As part of the mission planning process, the operational readiness of the ship is to be evaluated. The mission shall follow a phased operational profile consisting of 4 hours in Harbour, 12 hours during Transit, 8 hours conducting Anti-Piracy Operations, and 6 hours during Return Transit.
scenario.summary: The warship completed the assigned Anti-Piracy mission successfully by securing the designated maritime corridor, escorting vulnerable merchant vessels, and deterring hostile pirate activity through sustained surveillance and interdiction operations. All identified suspicious contacts were investigated, and no commercial vessels were compromised during the mission. Mission-critical propulsion, navigation, communication, and surveillance systems remained fully operational throughout the deployment, enabling successful mission completion and maintaining operational readiness for subsequent tasking.

scenario.missionStatement: At approximately 2026-05-12T03:20:00Z, the Maritime Operations Centre (MOC), Mumbai, received a distress signal from the merchant vessel MV Ocean Crest located at approximately 14.8620°N, 69.4750°E, nearly 420 nautical miles southwest of Mumbai Port. scenario.summary: The warship completed the assigned Search and Rescue mission successfully, covering a transit distance of approximately 840 nautical miles (round trip). Rescue operations resulted in the safe evacuation of survivors, delivery of emergency medical assistance, and coordination with aerial rescue assets. All mission-critical systems remained operational throughout the deployment, enabling successful completion of the assigned objectives despite adverse weather conditions. scenario.missionStatement: At approximately 2026-07-08T00:38:54Z, the Maritime Operations Centre (MOC), Mumbai, received an emergency distress alert from the offshore supply vessel MV Sea Guardian located at approximately 17.4250°N, 70.1840°E, nearly 280 nautical miles west of Mumbai Port. Several crew members were reported missing after abandoning the vessel in life rafts, while others required urgent medical assistance. A naval warship is required to proceed to the designated area, establish on-scene command, conduct coordinated search operations, recover survivors, provide emergency medical treatment, and coordinate rescue efforts with maritime patrol aircraft and Coast Guard units. scenario.summary: The designated warship successfully reached the distress location and established on-scene command for coordinated Search and Rescue operations. Through systematic search patterns and coordination with maritime patrol aircraft and Coast Guard units, all identified survivors were located, rescued, and provided immediate medical assistance. The damaged vessel was secured until additional support arrived, and all assigned rescue objectives were completed safely despite deteriorating weather conditions. Mission-critical propulsion, navigation, communication, and medical support systems remained fully operational throughout the deployment, enabling successful mission completion and safe return to base.
